name: Return to Quinn (Again)

angles.text: Quinn Yorick's fear of deteriorating into a mindless ghoul underscores the delicate balance Forsaken endure to preserve their free will and physical faculties.
Aiding distressed travelers and outcasts in Silverpine Forest secures Horde influence throughout the plagued lands north of the Sepulcher.

faq.answer: Quinn Yorick is an afflicted traveler located at the Ivar Patch, just north of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He requires special alchemical concoctions to stave off severe physical degeneration and recover enough strength to travel.

aliases: why does quinn need a potion
faq.answer: The potion is brewed specifically to aid Quinn Yorick's recovery and prevent his condition from worsening. Without it, Quinn feared he would succumb to deterioration and degenerate into a mindless ghoul.
faq.q: What is Quinn's Potion and why does he need it?

faq.answer: The Ivar Patch is a designated plot located directly north of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, serving as Quinn Yorick's temporary shelter while he recovers.
faq.q: Where is the Ivar Patch located?

aliases: what is quinn potion made of
faq.answer: The remedy delivered to Quinn is an alchemical concoction brewed with extracts drawn from six whole hearts, prepared to halt his bodily decay.
faq.q: What are the ingredients in Quinn's potion?

aliases: does quinn turn into a ghoul
faq.answer: Upon drinking the freshly delivered potion, Quinn feels its restorative effects take hold immediately, reporting that he will soon be fit to resume his travels rather than devolving into a ghoul.
faq.q: Does the potion successfully cure Quinn Yorick?

faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher brews the potion, using the extract of six whole hearts. He hands it over with characteristic bureaucratic impatience, eager to dismiss the courier before more paperwork is created.
faq.q: Who brews the potion for Quinn?

sections.body: North of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, Quinn Yorick rests at the Ivar Patch while suffering from an affliction that threatens his very mind and body. To halt his condition, a specialized alchemical mixture brewed from six hearts is dispatched to his encampment. For the Forsaken and their allies, delivering such remedies is a vital step in aiding wandering kin before rot and madness take hold.
sections.title: A Desperate Remedy

sections.body: Quinn was on the verge of accepting a grim fate: devolving into a mindless ghoul. Upon receiving and consuming the freshly brewed potion, the remedy takes effect immediately, restoring his vitality and allowing him to prepare for upcoming travels across the plagued landscape.
sections.title: Averting Degeneration

summary: Return to Quinn (Again) is a delivery quest in Silverpine Forest where a courier brings a restorative alchemical mixture to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch. The specialized concoction prevents Quinn from deteriorating into a mindless ghoul, restoring his strength so he may resume traveling.
attribution: In-game quest text: Return to Quinn (Again)
